title: MC Anti VPN
description: A plugin that provides you a protection against vpn users
body:
# McAntiVPN

**McAntiVPN** is a plugin that protects your server against players using a VPN.  
It uses the Proxy & VPN detection API: [IPHub.info](https://iphub.info).  

⚠️ To use it, you must create an account on the website and get an **API key**.  
- The free plan allows **1000 requests/day**.  
- The plugin avoids multiple requests on the same IP, so this limit should be enough.  

---

## ⚠️ Important
**Do not touch the `savedIps.json` file!**  
Any modification will **delete your data**.  
I will not be responsible for any data loss.  

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
The plugin has a `config.yml` file so you can customize it.  
You can use the `&` character to add colors in your messages.  

Available options:  

- **KickMessage**: The message shown when a player is kicked for using a VPN.  
- **CommandPermission**: Permission required to use the `/showiplist` command.  
- **PermissionNotify**: Permission needed to receive a notification when a player tries to connect with a VPN.  
- **DontHavePermissionMessage**: Message shown if a player does not have permission.  
- **PlayerWithVPNTriedToConnect**: Notification message when a player with a VPN tries to connect.  
- **API_KEY**: Your IPHub API key (get it from their website).
